name: ai.llmbenchmark/llmbenchmark
title: LLMBenchmark.ai
description: Which LLM for which task: benchmark scores and API prices for 400+ models. Free, no key.

tools.name: recommend_model
tools.description:
Which model should I use for this task? Maps the task text to a category (coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge,
        web design, or overall when nothing matches) by a fixed keyword map, filters by output price per million tokens, context
        length and open weights, and ranks by that category's benchmark board. Deterministic, no LLM call. Returns top_k models with
        scores, rank, prices, context, page URLs and a one-line reason. overall is the LLMBenchmark Index: a weighted mean of the Vibe Coding Index, the agentic, reasoning, math and knowledge indexes, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the LMArena text Elo, with a 90% margin.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description:
The top models on one category's board. category is one of overall, coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge, design
        (see list_categories). limit is 1 to 50. overall is the LLMBenchmark Index: a weighted mean of the Vibe Coding Index, the agentic, reasoning, math and knowledge indexes, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the LMArena text Elo, with a 90% margin.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description:
Two models side by side: score on every category board where both were measured, prices, context. Names are matched
        loosely: 'claude opus', 'gpt-5' or a slug all work.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model: maker, release date, prices, context, open weights, and its score and rank on every category board. Name or slug.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: API prices (USD per million tokens), cheapest output price first: the maker's own price when it serves the model on OpenRouter, else the median of providers (price_basis says which), plus the cheapest provider. Filter by model name and/or maker; limit is 1 to 100.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories recommend_model and get_leaderboard know, the benchmark board behind each, and the task keywords that select it.
